column34: $What do you do when you’re alone?$

column9: $아무 소리도 들려오지 않는 순간에, 나는 명상을 해. $
column10: $In the moments when no sound comes from anywhere, I meditate.$
$When outside stimuli dramatically decreases… my senses sharpen.$

column9: $나의 힘도 더 선명하게 느껴지고, 별가루도 한층 더 강하게 느껴져.$
column10: $My power feels clearer, and the stardust feels stronger.$

column9: $세상과의 차단막이 세워지고, 나의 내면에 오롯히 집중하는…$
column10: $A barrier from the world goes up, and I focus solely inward…$

column9: $나의 신경이 가장 날카롭게 세워지는 그런 중요한 정신 집중의 그 순간에…!$
column10: $That crucial moment when my nerves are at their sharpest…!$
$...That’s when Chrisso’s foolish voice comes echoing in.$
$Hi, Ribby. What’s going on?$
column34: $What do you do when you’re alone?$

column10: $Hi, Ribby. What’s going on?$
column34: $What do you do when you’re alone?$

column10: $Hi, Ribby. What’s going on?$
column34: $What do you do when you’re alone?$

column10: $Hmm. Yes, yes.$

column9: $우리들을 긴 잠에서 깨운 것이 바로 네 녀석이로군!$
column10: $So you’re the one who awakened us from our long slumber!$

column9: $만나서 반갑구나. 나는 양 별자리, 크리소라고 한다.$
column10: $It’s good to finally meet you. I am Chryso, the Ram constellation.$

column9: $직접 마주보고 감사 인사를 전할 수 있어서 다행이야.$
column10: $I’m glad I could thank you in person.$
$Hello, Chryso! My name is Ribby.$

column9: $우주를 다시 빛나게 만들기 위한 여행을 하고 있었죠!$
column10: $I was on a journey to make the universe shine again!$

column9: $이야기는 얼추 전해 들었다. 우리가 별가루를 모으는 것을 도와주겠다고 했지?$
column10: $I’ve heard the story roughly. You offered to help us gather stardust, right?$

column9: $이미 큰 도움을 받았는데... 우릴 계속 도와주기만 해도 괜찮나?$
column10: $You’ve already helped so much… is it really fine to keep helping us?$

column9: $걱정하지 마세요. 우주를 위해서라면 반드시 제가 해야만 하는 일인 걸요?$
column10: $Don’t worry. If it’s for the universe, it’s something I must do.$

column9: $으하하핫! 좋아, 그럼 사양 않고 감사히 받도록 하지!$
column10: $Wahahaha! Very well, then I’ll gladly accept without hesitation!$

column9: $별자리들에게 필요한 것들은 조금씩 달라질 수 있으니까…$
column10: $What each constellation needs may vary a little…$

column9: $무엇을 해야 할 지 혹시나 잊어버리게 된다면 나침반을 잘 활용해 보라고.$
column10: $If you ever forget what to do, make good use of the compass.$
$And if you ever need someone to talk to, come by anytime!$
$Alright. Leave it to me!$
$Ooooh, this is… a “Starflower”!$

column9: $좋아, 굳이 이 몸이 나서지 않아도 아주 잘 해내고 있는 것 같은데!$
column10: $Good, it looks like you’re doing wonderfully without me even stepping in!$
$I’m glad it seems to please you!$

column9: $나에게 별가루를 많이 가져다 줄 수록, 내가 가진 별자리의 힘도 점점 강해지지.$
column10: $The more stardust you bring me, the stronger the power of my constellation will grow.$

column9: $그렇게 되면 이 곳에서 할 수 있는 일들도 점점 더 많아질거야.$
column10: $And when that happens, the things I can do here will gradually increase as well.$
$So, about that…$

column9: $...혹시 별꽃 말고도 다른 별가루도 만들 수 있나?$
column10: $...Could you perhaps create other types of stardust besides Starflowers?$

column9: $음… 별자리 부동산에서 새로운 것을 한번 찾아 볼까요?$
column10: $Hmm… shall we look for something new in the Constellation Real Estate?$
$That’s a great idea!$
$Good heavens, this time it’s “Starhoney”!$
$Ahh, this sweet fragrance…!!$
$Truly, stardust is beautiful in any form.$
$You really do seem to love stardust.$

column9: $너무 오랜만이라 그런가, 기대감에 심장이 멈추질 않는다네.$
column10: $Maybe it’s because it’s been so long… my heart won’t stop racing with excitement.$

column9: $아아, 별가루… 나의 빛, 나의 삶, 나의 기쁨…$
column10: $Ahh, stardust… my light, my life, my joy…$
$Ahahaha… I didn’t expect you to love it this much…$
$I’d better prepare even more of it.$
$Mmm, hmm…$
$Without a doubt, this is top quality… simply excellent!$
$Do the other constellations also love stardust this much?$
$Of course!$

column9: $우리들은 말이지, 별가루 없이는 제대로 살아갈 수가 없다니까.$
column10: $We cannot live properly without stardust.$

column9: $개인마다 정도의 차이는 있겠지만. 어쨌거나 반드시 필요한 거라고.$
column10: $Though the degree may differ for each of us, it’s something absolutely essential.$
$I see…$

column9: $그런 의미에서, 조금만 더 갖다 주게. 흐흐흐…$
column10: $In that case, bring me just a little more. Hehehe…$
$...Ohh, ohhh!$
$Uoooooooh!!!$
$I can feel my strength returning!!$
$What a thundering voice…$

column9: $좋았어!! 덕분에 무기력하기만 한 상태에서 벗어날 수 있었다고!$
column10: $Excellent!! Thanks to you, I’ve broken free from that powerless state!$
$(That powerless state was just now…?)$

column9: $후우, 난 이만하면 꽤나 받은 것 같네. $
column10: $Phew, I think I’ve received quite enough.$

column9: $아직 계속할 마음이 있다면, 다른 녀석들에게도 가 보는 것이 어때?$
column10: $If you’re still willing, why not go visit the others as well?$

column9: $다른 별자리 님들은 어디에서 만날 수 있나요?$
column10: $Where can I meet the other constellations?$
$The same way you came here!$

column9: $망원경에 얼굴을 가까이 대면… 다른 곳으로 갈 수 있지!$
column10: $Bring your face close to the telescope… and you can travel to another place!$

column9: $언제든 돌아오는 것도 가능하니 나랑 헤어지는 일에 너무 아쉬워 말라고!$
column10: $You can always come back too, so don’t be too sad about parting with me!$

column9: $누구를 만나거든, 내 안부나 좀 전해 줘. 나는 잘 지내고 있다고.$
column10: $When you meet someone, give them my regards. Tell them I’m doing well.$
$See you again, Chryso!$

column9: $오오, 여전히 나에게 신경 써 주는 건가!$
column10: $Ohh, you’re still thinking of me!$

column9: $정말 고마운 걸! 어떻게 보답을 해야 할 지 모르겠어.$
column10: $Thank you so much! I don’t even know how to repay you.$

column9: $뭔가를 도와주고 싶어도, 넌 하나부터 열까지 척척 잘 하니까 말야!$
column10: $Even if I wanted to help, you handle everything so perfectly from start to finish!$
$Hahaha! You’ve worked hard!$

column9: $꽤나 적응한 모양인데, 어때. 일은 잘 되어 가나?$
column10: $It seems you’ve adapted quite well. So, how’s it going? Is the work going smoothly?$

column9: $언제든 심심하면 나랑 떠들면서 시간 보내도 괜찮아.$
column10: $If you’re ever bored, you’re welcome to spend time chatting with me.$
$…Actually, it does get a little lonely when I’m by myself.$
$Say, don’t you think there are a lot of picky eaters?$
$For me, Starflowers and Starhoney are more than enough.$

column9: $어때, 리비. 내가 최고지? 제일 안 힘들고, 그렇지?$
column10: $What do you think, Ribby? I’m the best, right? The least troublesome, don’t you agree?$
$...Hey, Ribby.$

column9: $아주 예전에, 우리에게 별가루를 모아 가져다주던 사람들이 있었어. $
column10: $Long ago, there were people who used to gather stardust for us.$

column9: $너가 지금 우리에게 해 주는 것처럼 말야.$
column10: $Just like you’re doing for us now.$
$They were truly wonderful people, but they’re gone now.$

column9: $그런 멋진 녀석들은, 한 곳에 오래 머무르기보다는 이곳저곳 여행하기를 좋아하니까.$
column10: $Such remarkable folks preferred to travel from place to place, rather than staying in one spot.$
$Thank you, Ribby.$
$…Mmm!$

column9: $뭐, 이제 나에게는 충분한 양의 별가루가 모인 것 같군!$
column10: $Well, it seems I’ve gathered enough stardust for myself now!$

column9: $아직 도움이 필요한 녀석들이 있을 테니, 다른 곳으로 가 보는게 어떻겠나?$
column10: $There must be others still in need, so why don’t you visit them?$

column9: $그동안 정말 수고 많았다고, 나의 친구 리비. 이 은혜는 잊지 못할 거야!$
column10: $You’ve really worked hard all this time, my friend Ribby. I’ll never forget this kindness!$
$Hello, Ribby.$

column9: $앗, 안녕하세요, 별자리 님! 다시 뵙게 되었네요!$
column10: $Ah, hello, Constellation! We meet again!$

column9: $금방 다시 만났네. 그동안 별 일 없었니?$
column10: $We met again so soon. Nothing much happened in the meantime?$

column9: $크리소 님을 만났어요! 잘 지내고 있다고, 안부 전해 달라고 하셨어요.$
column10: $I met Chryso! He asked me to tell you he’s doing well.$
$So you were already helping us… I’m so grateful.$

column9: $아, 참. 그렇지. 이전에 만났을 땐 정말 정신이 없었지?$
column10: $Ah, right. That’s true. When we first met, things were really hectic, weren’t they?$

column9: $정식으로 소개할게. 나의 이름은 이오, 황소 별자리 이오라고 해.$
column10: $Let me introduce myself properly. My name is Io, the Taurus Constellation.$
$It’s nice to meet you, Io, after such a long time!$

column9: $응, 혹시나 궁금한 게 있다면 나를 찾아와 줘.$
column10: $Yes, if you ever feel curious about something, come to me.$
$I always welcome a comfortable chat.$
$Thank you.$

column9: $이렇게나 우리를 도와주는 건 몇 번이나 감사를 해도 모자라겠는걸.$
column10: $No matter how many times I thank you, it won’t be enough for helping us this much.$

column9: $너무 무리하는 건 아니길 바랄게. 혹시라도… 걱정이 되어서 그래.$
column10: $I just hope you’re not overdoing it. I only worry about that, you see.$

column9: $걱정 마세요! 쉬는 것도, 일하는 것도, 필요한 만큼 하고 있으니까요!$
column10: $Don’t worry! I’m resting and working only as much as I need!$

column9: $정말 대견한걸… 그 작은 몸으로 어떻게 이런 일들을 하는 건지.$
column10: $Truly admirable… how you can manage all this with such a small body.$
$Then, I’ll ask this of you.$
$…I really like stardust.$

column9: $다른 친구들은 별꿀, 별꽃… 심지어는 젤리를 만들어 먹는 녀석도 있어.$
column10: $Other friends like Starhoney, Starflowers… there’s even one who makes jelly.$
$Castro especially likes stardust made into jelly.$
$Pios once made cake out of stardust.$
$Stardust cake…! I’d love to try that too!$

column9: $이름만 들어도 반짝반짝 달콤한 맛이 날 것 같은데요!$
column10: $Just the name alone sounds sparkly and sweet!$
$Uh…$
$Um, well. You see.$
$How should I explain this?$
$You see, stardust isn’t something you eat.$

column9: $별가루는 먹는 게 아니라구요? 그러면 케이크랑 젤리랑 그거는 다…$
column10: $Stardust isn’t something to eat? Then what about the cake and jelly and all that…$
$It’s really difficult to explain… hmm.$

column9: $아무튼! 별가루는 먹는 게 아니야! 그것만은 알아 둬.$
column10: $Anyway! Stardust isn’t for eating! Just keep that in mind.$
$I’ll explain more clearly… when the time comes.$

column9: $이오 님, 제가 곰곰히 생각을 해 보았는데요.$
column10: $Io, I’ve been thinking about something.$
$…Hm? About what?$

column9: $별가루가 먹는 게 아니라면, 별자리 님들은 별가루를 어디에 쓰시는 거에요?$
column10: $If stardust isn’t for eating, then what do you constellations use it for?$
$Well…$

column9: $별가루는… 우리의 근원이자, 구성 물질… 뭐 그런…$
column10: $Stardust is… our origin, our essence… something like that…$
$No. Stardust is for eating.$

column9: $맛있게 먹는 거야. 숨겨서 아껴 뒀다가 남 몰래 꺼내 먹어.$
column10: $We eat it deliciously. We hide it away and secretly take it out to eat later.$
$I’ve made up my mind.$
$Uh, huh? What decision?$

column9: $별자리 님들이 별가루를 어디에 쓰는 건지 궁금해졌어요.$
column10: $I’ve become curious about what you constellations truly use stardust for.$

column9: $이오 님이 제대로 대답해주시기 전까지 전 아무것도 하지 않을 거에요.$
column10: $Until you give me a proper answer, I won’t do anything.$
$You won’t do anything… what do you mean…$

column9: $별가루를 만들고 배달하는 것도 안 할 거에요.$
column10: $I won’t make or deliver stardust either.$
$…Gasp.$
$Alright, I understand. I give up. I’ll tell you.$
$Yay!$

column9: $대신, 별가루 조금만 가져다 줄래? 그러면 알려 줄게.$
column10: $But in return, could you bring me just a little stardust? Then I’ll tell you.$
$Really? You promise?$

column9: $물론이야. 우주의 신들은 약속을 어기는 법이 없지.$
column10: $Of course. Gods of the universe never break their promises.$

column9: $이오 님! 약속대로 별가루를 가져 왔어요! 이제 별가루의 비밀에 대해 알려주시는 건가요?$
column10: $Io! I brought the stardust as promised! Now will you tell me the secret of stardust?$
$Persistent, aren’t you, our Ribby.$

column9: $저의 성실함과 끈기는 크리소 님도 인정해 주셨지요.$
column10: $Even Chryso acknowledged my diligence and persistence.$
$Then now… it’s time for the truth!$
$Haa…$
$Alright, a promise is a promise.$
$Stardust, you see… it isn’t food.$
$Stardust is actually…!$
$(…gulp)$
$…When you eat it, it makes you feel good.$
$…That’s it?$
$Yes. That’s all.$
$You’re teasing me, aren’t you!$

column9: $전애도 말했지만, 우주의 신들은 약속을 어기는 일이 없어.$
column10: $As I said before, gods of the universe never break their promises.$
$I only told you the truth.$

column9: $아까는 대단한 비밀이 있는 것 처럼 숨기려고 하셨잖아요! 왜 그러신건가요?$
column10: $Earlier you acted like it was some grand secret you had to hide! Why did you do that?$
$But…$
$Seeing you react so amusingly like this…$
$Sorry, Ribby.$
$Ha, haha…$
$…Ribby, are you mad?$

column9: $아아뇨. 화가 나진 않았어요. 조금 허무하긴 했는데!$
column10: $No, not mad. Just a little disappointed!$

column9: $나 같은 사람들은 다른 사람이랑 장난 칠 기회가 많이 없거든… $
column10: $People like me don’t get many chances to play pranks on others…$
$Thank you for playing along. Hehe.$
$I’ll be counting on you from now on too.$

column9: $정말 굉장한 걸. 나의 힘이 거의 돌아온 것 같아.$
column10: $Truly amazing. I feel like most of my strength has already returned.$
$At an incredible pace, Ribby.$

column9: $그런가요…? 저는 제가 너무 느린 건 아닐까 생각하고 있었어요.$
column10: $Really…? I was thinking maybe I’m too slow.$

column9: $크리소 님에게 별가루를 모아드리는 일은 지금보다 훨씬 빨리 끝났거든요.$
column10: $When I gathered stardust for Chryso, it ended much faster.$

column9: $크리소는 바보라서 그래. 바보는 감기에도 안 걸린다고 하잖아?$
column10: $That’s because Chryso’s a fool. You know what they say, fools don’t even catch colds?$
$Overflowing with foolish energy, his recovery is unbelievably fast.$

column9: $그 녀석은 별가루를 안 주고 1년 동안 방치해도 소리를 지르면서 뛰어다닐거야.$
column10: $Even if you left him without stardust for a year, he’d still be running around shouting.$
$Indeed… yes, that really does sound like him…$
$You’ve worked so hard, Ribby!$

column9: $나는 이제 혼자서도 끄떡 없어. 다른 친구들을 도와 주면 좋겠어.$
column10: $Now I can manage on my own. I’d like you to help the others.$
$I really enjoyed being with you, Io!$

column9: $그렇게 영원히 이별하는 사람처럼 말하지는 말고… 하하..$
column10: $Don’t speak as if we’re parting forever… haha…$
$I can always come back anytime.$

column9: $그래. 언제든 또 돌아올 수 있으니까, 그렇지?$
column10: $Yes. You can always come back anytime, right?$
$Let’s meet again.$
$See you again soon!$
$You’ve returned, Ribby. How are things going?$
$And once again, you’ve brought me stardust.$
$As kind as ever. Make yourself at home.$
$Stardust is truly mysterious.$

column9: $꿀이 되든, 사탕이 되든, 쿠키가 되든… 그 본질을 잃지 않아.$
column10: $Whether it becomes honey, candy, or cookies… it never loses its essence.$

column9: $이상하지 않아? 우리 별자리들마저도 정확한 정체를 몰라.$
column10: $Isn’t it strange? Even we constellations don’t know its true nature.$

column9: $별자리와 별들을 구성하는 가장 기본적이고 근본적인 구성이라는 것 이외에는…$
column10: $Aside from being the most basic and fundamental element that forms the constellations and stars…$

column9: $그런 걸로 고작 케이크나 만들어 먹는다는 건 어딘가 우스운 일이야.$
column10: $Using something like that just to make cake seems a little ridiculous.$
$Lately, it’s gotten much noisier around here.$

column9: $별자리들이 하나 둘씩 잠에서 깨어나고, 별들이 빛나기 시작하고…$
column10: $Constellations are waking one by one, stars are beginning to shine again…$

column9: $물론, 정말 멋진 일이야. 다 리비 네 덕분이지.$
column10: $Of course, it’s a truly wonderful thing. All thanks to you, Ribby.$

column9: $그렇지만 가끔은... 빛 사그라들어 버린 그 날 이후의 정적이 그립기도 해.$
column10: $But sometimes… I miss the stillness after the day the light faded.$

column9: $다른 별자리들과 다르게, 난 그런 게 무섭지 않았거든.$
column10: $Unlike the other constellations, I wasn’t afraid of that silence.$
$…I’ve thought about it a little.$

column9: $그래도 역시, 시끌벅적한 게 좋은 것 같아.$
column10: $But still, I think I like the liveliness better.$

column9: $나는 조용하고, 아무도 없는 곳에서 혼자만의 시간을 보내길 좋아해.$
column10: $I enjoy spending time alone in a quiet place where no one else is around.$

column9: $그리고, 그러한 성향이 나보다 더욱 강한 사람들도 있겠지.$
column10: $And there must be others who feel that even more strongly than I do.$

column9: $하지만, 그 사람들도 반드시 한번은 바깥의 소리를 들으러 나갈 필요가 있어.$
column10: $But even they need to go outside and hear the sounds at least once.$
$Chryso was always bothering me at my side…$
$But when there was no one by me and I needed someone…$

column9: $옆에서 귀찮게 굴어 준 것도 그 녀석이었으니까.$
column10: $The one who pestered me at my side was him.$
$…I’m grateful for that.$
$Huuuuh… It’s been so long since I last saw stardust.$

column9: $아직 더 필요해. 더 갖다 주게. 더.$
column10: $I still need more. Bring me more. More!$
$Take it easy, I’m not going to eat you!$
$You’re working really hard…$
$It’s also been a long time since I’ve been this awake.$
$I wonder if Nemea is doing well?$
$Uoooooohhh!!!!!$
$Mmm… Mmmhh…!!$
$Sniff-$
$…Waaahhh!!! Why are you staring at me like that!$

$Are you curious about something?$
$If you need anything, come anytime.$
$I’d be glad if I could help…$
$For some reason, I feel good today.$
$I’m glad you’re here.$
$Hello~ Are you looking at me?$
$Hmm…$
$…A- a-choo!!$
$It’s a good day!$
$Nice to meet you!$
$Need any help? Just say the word!$
$If I get the chance, I’d like to go see my friends.$

column9: $가끔은 그 아이가 대체 무슨 생각을 하는지…$
column10: $Sometimes I really wonder what that kid is thinking…$
$You’re always so diligent, my friend.$
$I’m watching you, cheering for you!$
$Ahh, stardust… I’m truly grateful…$
$H-huh? ...Why?$

$Uh, uh, w-well, um… sorry.$
